description: Manage a webhook endpoint's forwarding rules - part of its config. Every request matching a rule is also delivered to its callback URL, HMAC-signed, with retries, until the rule is removed (the create secret verifies X-OtterKit-Signature; shown once). An optional transform template reshapes the delivery: placeholders like {{data.object.id}} pull from the JSON body ({{$method}}, {{$path}}, {{$body}}, {{$header.name}} are built-ins) - e.g. shape a Slack message and point callbackUrl at a Slack webhook. destination 'email' emails the owner instead (throttled, no callback); destination 'push' sends Web Push notifications to every device the owner enabled in the console (console.otterkit.com -> webhook -> Notifications). Actions: add, list, remove.

callbackUrl.description: add: URL matching requests are delivered to

destination.description: add: where matches go - 'url' (default, needs callbackUrl), 'email' (throttled owner email), or 'push' (Web Push to the owner's enabled devices, max 1/min per rule)

fieldPath.description: add: JSON body dot-path, e.g. event.type

method.description: add: only match this HTTP method

path.description: add: only match paths with this prefix

requireVerified.description: add: only deliver requests whose inbound signature verified 'valid' (needs verification armed on the endpoint)

script.description: add: JavaScript run per match in a sandboxed isolate (no network, 50ms CPU) - export default {transform(req)} returning string | {body, contentType?} | object (JSON) | null (skip); req is {method, path, headers, text, json}. Mutually exclusive with transform

token.description: Session connect token (defaults to a local daemon record)

transform.description: add: template delivered instead of the raw capture, e.g. {"text": "paid {{data.object.amount}}"}

transformContentType.description: add: Content-Type of the transformed delivery (default application/json)

name: webhook_forwarding
